subject: Emotions
title: Unrequited Love
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Unrequited Love.

hook.text: He loves her. She doesn't love him back. His brain treats it like withdrawal—because chemically, it is.

buildup.text: Roy Baumeister found that 98% of people have experienced unrequited love—as the lover, the beloved, or both.

discovery.text: The rejected lover's brain shows increased activity in the ventral tegmental area—the same region as drug craving.

twist.text: The beloved suffers too. Guilt, discomfort, and pressure to reciprocate create genuine distress on the other side.

climax.text: Unrequited love persists because hope activates dopamine. As long as there's a chance, the reward system stays online.

punchline.text: Unrequited love is addiction to a person who isn't your drug.

quiz.question: What brain area activates during unrequited love?
